up: Retrieve all bioactivity details for compound CHEMBL221959 (Tofacitinib) and all its related salts against the target CHEMBL2971 (Tyrosine-protein kinase JAK2). Include only IC50 measurements. To identify the parent compound and all related salts, use the molecule_hierarchy table: find all child compounds where parent_molregno corresponds to the molregno of CHEMBL221959. For the resulting set of compounds (parent and salts), join to activities via the compound_records table using the record_id link, and retrieve publication information via the docs table linked from compound_records. Return the following columns for each matching activity record: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
sql:
WITH target_set AS (
    SELECT molregno, chembl_id, pref_name, organism
    FROM molecule_dictionary
    WHERE chembl_id IN (
        SELECT chembl_id FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL221959')
        UNION
        SELECT md.chembl_id FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.molregno = md.molregno WHERE mh.parent_molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL221959')
    )
)
SELECT 
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM target_set md
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';

up: Retrieve all IC50 bioactivity records in nM for compound CHEMBL221959 (Tofacitinib) and all its related salts against target CHEMBL2971 (Tyrosine-protein kinase JAK2). To identify the compound set, use the molecule_hierarchy table: select CHEMBL221959 as the parent and retrieve all child molregnos where parent_molregno matches the parent's molregno. Join these compounds to activities using the exact FAQ salts pattern: join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to activities on record_id. Retrieve publication information by joining docs to compound_records on doc_id. Return the following columns for each activity: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
    SELECT parent.molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL221959'
    UNION
    SELECT child.molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
    JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL221959'
)
SELECT 
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM compound_set cs_base
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cs_base.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
